target.statement: S2L-PO with a 1.7B explorer guiding an 8B model achieves 23.8 Pass@1 on AIME24, versus 15.0 for the standard GRPO baseline (+8.8), the paper's headline improvement.

compute.basis: The target is a full 8B-parameter GRPO training run on DAPO17k using 8 NVIDIA L20 GPUs, so it cannot be reproduced on an 8-core CPU-only laptop; the time estimate is effectively unbounded on such hardware.

blockers: needs 8 NVIDIA L20 GPUs (or equivalent multi-GPU training)
8B GRPO training exceeds 16 GB laptop RAM and CPU-only compute
requires long RL rollout generation and large model checkpoints
title: Smaller Models are Natural Explorers for Policy-Level Diversity in GRPO
